item.title: By: Jesper Rønn-Jensen
item.dc:creator: Jesper Rønn-Jensen
item.description:
Thanks for your comment, Phil! I have now replaced the url

from
justaddwater.dk/2005/12/02/yahoo-alerts-mail-rss/#respond
to
#respond

I really hope Akismet picks this up. (actually i accidentally marked the comment as spam with our justaddwater.dk url, so I hope Akismet does not misunderstand it)

item.title: By: Phil
item.dc:creator: Phil
item.description: That is weird, I’ve never seen that before! Perhaps the spammers are trying to give decent sites a bad name. I’d remove your link and send it off to Akismet to deal with, at least you can’t be attached to it then.
